did: Designed IW8 and IW9 as a phone prototype the owner agreed to: a study page with a good, another good and a poor answer, a ladder of four rungs, a voice-paced teleprompter mock, and read-aloud as its own section. Then built IW8's format and routine half: some-ui.interview-week/2, with each question's ground and its ready answer checked against the body of work at the commit, one question a day, and the mailbox taking /2. Three fresh-context reviews, findings fixed. Relayed the owner's direct asks (open vs body-of-work questions, queryable metadata, stakes and nerves) and wrote the phone half's build plan on #3175.

calls.title: How many questions a day
options: one a day, nothing carried over
one a day, yesterday's carried over quietly
calls.why: The tiniest start for an avoided skill, and no quiet mark of a missed day; the owner agreed.
calls.undo: Change questionOfDay to take two, or to hold a question until a take answers it (C555).

calls.title: Where ready answers live
options: a second version of the week's file
a separate file with its own route on home
an optional field in the first version
calls.why: Home keeps the week byte for byte; an optional field would change what /1 means to shipped readers.
calls.undo: Drop /2 from the format, the mailbox and home, and move answers to their own file (C556).

calls.title: A question's ground
options: by family, written on the question
chosen per question by the model
calls.why: The owner set open and body-of-work questions apart and wants them queryable; code decides, never the model.
calls.undo: Change GROUND, or move a family to the other side (C557).

left: IW8's phone half: pages as routes, rungs on takes, the first take released, the retake call and its discard site (plan on #3175).
The essay reading ground and ready.
Widening the body of work to older pull requests.
#3178 is held until home accepts /2; the mailbox deploys after it merges.
